QuestInfo.name: Returned Secret Book
QuestInfo.1: I got #p320# all kinds of yummy snacks and finally got his dad's #t4031032# in exchange. I really want to take just one peek...
QuestInfo.2: I got #p608# the precious #t4031032# that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about #p320# at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... Well, it'd be best for #p320# to stay with the fairies, right? Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing this cumbersome armor in the sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and relax at the sauna...

0.0: Thank you so much for helping me with all my requests so far. Oh yeah, a promise is a promise... here's my dad's book. I have no idea what this book is about, but... why is he so gaga over this anyway??

1.0: Ohhh... this is the book! The book I was looking for... phew, thank you so much. I knew you'd bring it to me... Here, a piece of clothing like I promised... and this isn't much, but... here you go.

npc.0: Hehehe... I took off with my dad's precious book... but... this book... what's it for??? Why does my dad take such good care of it?? I have nooo idea...

item.0: You haven't found my son yet, huh. He took a very important book out with him. I'll definitely reward you handsomely for your work. He may be in a passage made of trees near the forest at #m10002000#.
